name: Rule whether the floor manager and the Maitre d are one role or two, and which owns the room
text_content:
Type: founder decision

Source: Session 3 of the Scaling People translation program, page section 13.3 of the S3 page in the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253. Session task 86ajgmhgx.

The white paper frees the Maitre d from the host stand "to hold the floor and the team." Canon 1.0 gives the room to "the floor manager," lists a floor manager and hosts among uniform roles with no Maitre d, and places a Maître d' at the porch steps. The deck 3.0 lists Maître d' and floor manager as two distinct uniform roles. The server's escalation destination, the transition trigger, and emergency authority all currently name "the owner of the room" and cannot name a seat. Brandon rules on the role identity; Session 8 designs the structure from the ruling.
